<!-- wg-report cycle=2026-10-30 group=wg:third-party-ready -->
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-29 11:30 to 2026-10-30 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one new escalation (decision 864eaebf, proposed).
- Fact: srs#991 drafts RFC-001 Revision 12 so a rendered page never jumps from a top heading to a third-level one (agent pages show that jump today). It amends an Accepted RFC, so the reviewer rejected on escalation and added gate:owner-merge.
- Why it matters: one rule for every document keeps a single way to decide heading levels, but it changes output on the 6 semanticops.com pages, and downstream repositories (muDemocracy.org) were not audited.
- Options: A. One rule for all (one outline rule; those pages change). B. Opt-in per Composition (nothing changes, a second way to decide). C. Do nothing (the jump stays).
- Recommendation: A, audit downstream before any fold. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low (a draft; no spec text changes until you merge it).
Still waiting on you, no ruling: needs-input srs-rust#1491, #1380, #1339, #1198, #1132, srs#928; the three open exercises (6b).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. No proposed decision has reviewer assent on a merged PR, so no group session was held. 8487fd7a (arrangement allowlist) rode in srs-programme#305, which merged 10-29 20:48 with no quorum comment and no assent, so it stays proposed.

3. Done: 9 group-labelled PRs merged this cycle (7 product PRs, 2 programme PRs; all merged by you).
- Quorum line present (builder tpr-builder / reviewer tpr-reviewer): srs-rust#1525 (diagnostic codes to kebab-case; findings none; mandate #1492), srs-rust#1530 (default .srs/README.md names the engine; mandate rfc-decision-1967b8eb), srs-vscode#157 (Diagnostic.code from the engine's code; ruling srs-rust#1264).
- Merged with no quorum line seen: srs#990 (llms.txt opens with Get running; owner-merge), srs-rust#1521 (start.md sample validates), srs-rust#1523 (repo_doctor MCP tool; owner-merge), srs-web#638 (app.semanticops.com llms.txt), srs-programme#305 (decision proposal) and #336 (last cycle's report).

4. Stuck or lost: 2 group PRs open (11:30 read of group-state said 1; srs#991 was updated 11:05).
- srs#991: waits on you (see 1). Its `pr-classification` has one failed run, undiagnosed.
- srs-rust#1487 (refuse updates that would invalidate records, #1484): red Test on 2eb1c3b, reviewer rejected 10-28 18:41, nothing pushed in 2 days. Needs the builder.
Quorum record is incomplete for the 6 PRs listed in 3 as having no line.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges by group-state (the count rolled over at 11:30); counted from PRs, 5 carried gate:auto-merge (srs-rust#1525, #1530, srs-vscode#157, srs-programme#305, #336), the others were owner merges. Open: 1 by group-state, room 9. Pause state: running (the last two reports both have a 👍).
5b. Awaiting ratification: 8487fd7a (arrangement fixture allowlist, age 3 days; PR merged without assent); c7a8e0a2 (note delete; you merged srs-rust#1497 on 10-28 as option A, record still not ratified, age 2 days); 864eaebf (new, above). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: **Queue running dry: 4 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** Open `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` issues not needs-input, not blocked, not parked: srs#236 (P0), srs#931 (P2), srs-rust#1495 (P2; waits for a week of green), srs-rust#1342 (P2; may already be served by merged work, not checked). Blocked: srs-rust#1496, srs-web#632. No local priorities set. Top 3 in the Builder's order: srs#236, srs#931, srs-rust#1342 (then #1495 by age). PRs in flight: 2; budget left 9. Possible sources: the spec-to-implementation drift list, the three open exercises, unparking of srs-rust#683 once its input is given. Waits on you: srs#991, the ratifications in 5b, the needs-input issues above. Fed by the analyst: no run seen since 2026-10-27 12:28 (queue fed, 11 filed).
6b. Exercises: three open, none listed in the SemanticOps log (the group's own): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (input: should reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable" (non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed); 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree" (input line not read). Build trigger: the logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: the review path keeps working, and now escalates correctly (srs#991 stopped at the Door 3 line rather than being approved), but the delegated budget sits at 0 of 10 for a third report running: work lands by owner merge, and quorum lines lag or are missing on about two thirds of merged PRs. A decision proposal merged without assent (8487fd7a) shows the proposal path has no review step. Measurement c027f838 (I1): note its window opened at 11:30 today, so it covers 2 PRs merged since the close, not this cycle: 0 of 2 grounded to a problem (0%), 0 of 2 with an affirmed persona and domain; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
